question: List the names of leagues that, in the 2012 season, had teams with above-average build-up play passing and also ranked among the top 5 leagues by total goals scored (home + away) across all seasons.

prediction.sql:
WITH avg_buildup AS (
  SELECT AVG(ta."XCL_181") AS global_avg
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ta."XCL_178") = '2012'
),
leagues_above_avg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l."XCL_003" AS league_id
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008"
  INNER JOIN Team t ON m."XCL_013" = t."XCL_171"
  INNER JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t."XCL_171" = ta."XCL_177"
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ta."XCL_178") = '2012'
    AND ta."XCL_181" > (SELECT global_avg FROM avg_buildup)
),
top5_goals AS (
  SELECT l."XCL_003" AS league_id
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008"
  GROUP BY l."XCL_003"
  ORDER BY SUM(m."XCL_015") + SUM(m."XCL_016") DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT l."XCL_005" AS league_name
FROM League l
WHERE l."XCL_003" IN (SELECT league_id FROM leagues_above_avg)
  AND l."XCL_003" IN (SELECT league_id FROM top5_goals)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH avg_buildup AS (
  SELECT AVG(ta."XCL_186") AS global_avg
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  INNER JOIN Team t ON ta."XCL_177" = t."XCL_171"
  INNER JOIN Match m ON t."XCL_171" = m."XCL_013"
  WHERE m."XCL_009" LIKE '%2012%'
),
leagues_above_avg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l."XCL_003" AS league_id
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008"
  INNER JOIN Team t ON m."XCL_013" = t."XCL_171"
  INNER JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t."XCL_171" = ta."XCL_177"
  WHERE m."XCL_009" LIKE '%2012%'
    AND ta."XCL_186" > (SELECT global_avg FROM avg_buildup)
),
top5_goals AS (
  SELECT l."XCL_003" AS league_id,
         SUM(m."XCL_015") + SUM(m."XCL_016") AS total_goals
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008"
  GROUP BY l."XCL_003"
  ORDER BY total_goals DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT l."XCL_005" AS league_name
FROM League l
WHERE l."XCL_003" IN (SELECT league_id FROM leagues_above_avg)
  AND l."XCL_003" IN (SELECT league_id FROM top5_goals)
